body:
I can confirm this on 4.5.dev 215acd52e.

The error message is set at this point in the `tooltip` variable:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1696ab0cb6ff3c77fa48985fa943c81be34a751a/editor/debugger/script_editor_debugger.cpp#L630-L635

I've looked into adding softwrap to 100 characters, but we don't have a built-in low-level function for it. This can be manually implemented using [`TextServer.string_get_word_breaks()`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_textserver.html#class-textserver-method-string-get-word-breaks) and looping over the resulting array two-by-two.

I reproduced this on `master` at [`c12e51972a`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/c12e51972a41665743be79c7d3e3fd5c871d97f3). I prototyped a systemic fix at the default tooltip layout layer in Viewport, rather than inserting line breaks into the Debugger string: - Measure the default `TooltipLabel` at its natural, unwrapped width. - Limit that width to the current usable screen/window width, accounting for the complete `PopupPanel` chrome. - Set the resulting minimum/maximum width, then enable `AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART`. - Defer `PRESET_FULL_RECT` until after measuring, so stretch anchors do not affect the tooltip height. The core change is in [`scene/main/viewport.cpp`, inside `Viewport::_gui_show_tooltip_at()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c12e51972a41665743be79c7d3e3fd5c871d97f3/scene/main/viewport.cpp#L1632-L1749): ```cpp const real_t natural_width = gui.tooltip_label->get_bound_minimum_size().x; const real_t popup_chrome_width = MAX(0.0, gui.tooltip_popup->get_contents_minimum_size().x - natural_width); const real_t available_width = MAX(1.0, (real_t)vr.size.x / popup_scale - popup_chrome_width); const real_t tooltip_width = MIN(natural_width, available_width); gui.tooltip_label->set_custom_minimum_size(Size2(tooltip_width, 0)); gui.tooltip_label->set_custom_maximum_size(Size2(tooltip_width, -1)); gui.tooltip_label->set_autowrap_mode(TextServer::AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART); Rect2 r(gui.tooltip_pos + tooltip_offset, gui.tooltip_popup->get_contents_minimum_size()); gui.tooltip_label->set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control::PRESET_FULL_RECT); ``` This keeps short tooltips at their natural width, wraps only overlong default tooltips, preserves the original text, and leaves custom tooltips unchanged. Would this direction be acceptable for a PR?
